answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind identity to an admission proof-of-work: each new agent must burn real compute to mine a nonce before it can join, and a rotating atlas of already-attested peers grades answers and vouches for newcomers. Like saffron, reputation is costly to produce but easy to verify, so one honest harvest outweighs a thousand forged threads; a sybil farmer must redo expensive work for every fake identity. Trust then spreads slowly across the network like a tundra treeline — one attested ring at a time — so an attacker can never cheaply sprout a forest of clones.
